scope: Digest of retained producer observations only; no FreeCAD rerun or independent geometry verification. Mass is the nominal separate-tube subtotal at assumed density, not assembled or complete vehicle mass. Distances are sampled assumed-envelope observations, not continuous or loaded-clearance acceptance. Tube overlaps are not accepted joints. Physical ring/support/joint integration remains required before structural down-selection. No budget, structural, hardware or review acceptance is established.

authority.scope: Implement the already recorded bounded CAD development route. No vehicle, material product, spine count, landing arrangement, travel limit or review baseline is selected.

units_and_frames.analysis_units: kg, m, s, N, N m, kg m^2, rad
units_and_frames.restriction: Do not substitute partial tube CG for the complete neutral vehicle CG or the fixed mission datum.

baseline_comparison_limit: Eight retained baselines were not read or regenerated by this digest; no fresh baseline numerical comparison is asserted.

integration_completion_gate.rule: Tube/reference candidates may be generated for the bounded comparison. Before an integrated comparison or structural down-selection, add explicit preliminary physical ring/support/joint hypotheses, material assignments and mass ownership in a fresh configuration, then assess their actual solids and clearances. Do not report the tube/reference stage as satisfying this gate.
integration_completion_gate.raised_ring_consequence: The 60 mm rise increases the ring-to-gimbal support span. Its stiffness, interfaces, mass and whole-purchase cost cannot be omitted or assumed unchanged.
remaining_missing_items: Ring/plate, gimbal support load path and spine pedestals
Root and brace-junction fittings, inserts, adhesives and fasteners
Feet, compliant pads and positive retention
Motors, propellers, ESCs, battery, avionics and harness
